reason: Re-opened packet.js veda 75 --verse 7.100.6 and the pinned revision itself (action=raw, words re-found; API timestamp 2019-09-26, so the year is right). Sāyaṇa opens with purā khalu viṣṇuḥ svaṃ rūpaṃ parityajya kṛtrimaṃ rūpāntaraṃ dhārayan saṃgrāme vasiṣṭhasya sāhāyyaṃ cakāra, taṃ jānann ṛṣir anayā pratyācaṣṭe, and under both his Nirukta-based construals (kutsitārtha and praśaṃsā) closes on the same purport: do not hide the Vaiṣṇava form, show us that radiant form. That carries 'Vasistha’s plea ... to appear in his own' without drift; the seer who addresses the verse is the one helped, and 7.100 is Vasiṣṭha’s hymn, so naming him is a sound reading of Sāyaṇa’s frame (Wilson’s note says the same). verse.js ok (7.100.6 at [615,6]), a whole verse from the text; entry-check ok. Plain sense checked on day.js: 7.100 is a Visnu hymn whose v3 and v4 give the strides and whose v5 to v7 dwell on the name Sipivista; 'a hymn on Visnu’s three strides' is a slight narrowing of a hymn that is equally on the name, but not false. No school, comparison or tone issue; the name’s indelicate sense (Wilson’s note) is omitted, not softened into something else.
